digest.component_or_area: Plan-review gate and completion-verifier evidence contract
propositions: Measurements lacking recorded context (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument type) cannot be validated for structural ability to have failed for the reason the reviewer cares about, allowing false-positive evidence through gates.

Four escapes occurred during epic 061c implementation: wrong account/region, live calls under overprivileged identity, simulator giving wrong authorization answer, and confidence outrunning method; all share the property that measurement context was not recorded or compared to project facts.

Deterministic enforcement of measurement-provenance fields in attested-evidence declarations allows existing repo-grounded gate criteria to detect contradictions between claim context and infrastructure code, without gates directly observing the world.

Plans asserting unchanged behavior across route/provider/substrate changes while citing only configuration (not the resolution path consuming it) remain invisible to reviewers, enabling defects that look like scope discipline.
The completion-verifier must not re-run world measurements to validate measurement provenance, as the verifier's own credentials carry the same privilege-masking problem that causes the escapes.

Measurement provenance must capture instrument type (live-call, simulation, static-analysis) because a simulator and live call are not interchangeable evidence for authorization claims despite both possibly declaring production-equivalent contexts.
